title: TCL 55S470G (S4 class Google TV, US; device G10, product G10_4K_US_NF, Realtek), 1.8 GB RAM
header:
TCL 55S470G (S4 class Google TV, US; device G10, product G10_4K_US_NF, Realtek), 1.8 GB RAM
Android 12 (Google TV), firmware STT2.230203.001, incremental AS50 -- same build as tcl-g10-google-tv

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55s470g/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> examples/tcl-55s470g/restore.sh   (or tools/restore.sh <this file> com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx)
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx. Live TV / HDMI app: com.tcl.tv.
Keep: com.tcl.tv, com.tcl.tvinput, com.tcl.dashboard, com.tcl.suspension, com.tcl.autopair,
com.tcl.systemserver, com.tcl.providers.config, com.tcl.initsetup, com.tcl.useragreement,
com.tcl.factory.view, com.tcl.globalkeyoverlay and all com.realtek.*.

Unlike the G10 units in tcl-g10-google-tv, nothing shipped disabled on this one: Samba TV,
logkit and ttvs were all enabled. com.tcl.ttvs is KEPT here on purpose: besides Samba ACR and TCL
BI analytics it hosts the firmware updater (versionUpdateApp SystemUpdateService) and T-Cast.
Disable it only if you don't want TV firmware updates. Opt out in Settings > Privacy > Samba
Interactive TV, and untick every entry under Manage providers there too (unticking the main switch
leaves those ticked).

Kept by choice: Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV, Paramount+, Tubi, TCLtv+,
TCL Live (com.tcl.channelplus), AirPlay, firmware updates.
No separate Miracast package on this firmware.

apps.note: Samba TV ACR front end (the frame service lives in ttvs, see above); re-enabled at every boot while ttvs is enabled, so also opt out in Settings
